sloka: एतत् सुनीतं मम दर्शनेन रामं हि दृष्ट्वैव भवेदनर्थः।इहैव ते सेत्स्यति मोत्सुको भूर्महानयुद्धेन सुखस्य लाभः ।। ६.६४.३५ ।।
transliteration: etat sunītaṁ mama darśanena rāmaṁ hi dṛṣṭvaiva bhavedanarthaḥ।ihaiva te setsyati motsuko bhūrmahānayuddhena sukhasya lābhaḥ ।। 6.64.35 ।।

translations.english: "To me this is the best course. As soon as you see Rama, do not be eager for war. It is meaningless. Great gain will accrue to you from here."
